LanguageData.RT_BMPT_Vehicle.label: BMPT Terminator
LanguageData.RT_BMPT_Vehicle.description:
Heavy tank support fighting vehicle with dual 30mm 2A42 autocannons, Ataka ATGMs, dual AG-17D automatic grenade launchers, and PKTM MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2, AG Operator x2 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - Dual 30mm 2A42: 30x173mm cartridge (FMJ / HE / AP-I) - Ataka ATGM: 9M120M AntiTank missile (HEAT) - 2x 30mm AG-17D AGL: 30x29mm grenade (HE / HE Time-Fuzed / HEDP / EMP / Smoke) - 7.62mm PKTM MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
